C18 and C16 are also close resignation-letter analogues, but their language and sequencing are less specifically aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Although I have known for more than two years that your retirement from government service could not be indefinitely postponed, the actual receipt of your letter of resignation fills me with profound regret. This I do with great reluctance.","explanation":"This is a highly distinctive shared opening sequence with close lexical correspondences: prior knowledge, imminent departure, actual receipt of the resignation, personal factors, and reluctant acceptance."},{"child_excerpt":"the extraordinary talents that, more than four years ago, you brought to the Treasury Department and for the loyal and tireless way in which you have, ever since, applied them to problems of the greatest import","parent_excerpt":"Your intellectual proficiency and skill, together with your strength of character and resolute spirit, have in a special way enlisted economics in the nation's service.","explanation":"Both letters follow acceptance with praise of exceptional personal abilities applied to national economic policy."},{"child_excerpt":"From time to time I know we shall want to call upon you for advice and counsel","parent_excerpt":"My own personal sense of loss is eased by the knowledge that you will be available to help us from time to time in the days ahead.","explanation":"Both conclude the official relationship by anticipating recurring future assistance, using the shared formulation “from time to time.”"}]}
